description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Config, which manages configuration directives for the HTMLPurifier library, including loading, setting, retrieving, and finalizing configuration options.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Config
classes.description: A class that manages configuration directives for HTMLPurifier, allowing creation, retrieval, setting, loading from files or arrays, and finalization of configuration settings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLPurifier_Config object from a given configuration source (object, array, or filename).

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Creates a default configuration object based on the schema.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific directive within a namespace.

methods.name: getBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all directives and their values within a namespace.

methods.name: getBatchSerial
methods.description: Returns an MD5 hash representing the current state of a namespace's directives.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns an MD5 hash representing the entire configuration's state.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all directives organized by namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of a directive within a namespace.

methods.name: _listify
methods.description: Helper function to create a comma-separated list of allowed values.

methods.name: getHTMLDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the HTML definition object.

methods.name: getCSSDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS definition object.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific type of definition object (HTML, CSS, URI).

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads configuration directives from an associative array.

methods.name: getAllowedDirectivesForForm
methods.description: Returns directives allowed in a web form context based on schema and allowed list.

methods.name: loadArrayFromForm
methods.description: Creates a configuration object from $_GET/$_POST form data.

methods.name: mergeArrayFromForm
methods.description: Merges form data directives into the current configuration object.

methods.name: prepareArrayFromForm
methods.description: Prepares an array from form data for loading into configuration.

methods.name: loadIni
methods.description: Loads directives from an ini file.

methods.name: isFinalized
methods.description: Checks if the configuration object is finalized.

methods.name: autoFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the configuration if auto-finalize is enabled.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the configuration, preventing further changes.
